schema.description: Structured result produced by the Decision Gate Topology Agent. The result returns an updated normal-flow topology draft where high-level decision gates may be inserted between MAIN_FLOW_POINT nodes.

normal_flow_topology_draft.description: Updated normal-flow topology draft after decision gates have been inserted. The nodes array may contain MAIN_FLOW_POINT nodes and DECISION_GATE nodes.

workflow_name.description: Short name of the parent workflow being analyzed. Usually copied from the input normal_flow_topology_draft.

topology_status.description: Review status of the updated topology. Use confirmed when the decision gate topology is coherent enough to continue. Use changes_requested when user review, topology revision, or branch creation is needed. Use cancelled only when the topology should not continue.

summary.description: Concise summary of how decision gates were inserted into the normal-flow topology, including important unresolved outcomes or missing branches.

nodes.description: Mixed list of topology nodes. Each item is either a MAIN_FLOW_POINT node or a DECISION_GATE node. Connections may reference wfpoint_id, decision_gate_id, or outcome_id.

clarification_questions.description: Concrete questions for the user that would help confirm, correct, or complete the decision gate topology.

main_flow_point_node.description: A normal-flow topology point inherited from the previous normal-flow topology draft. It represents a high-level waypoint in the normal workflow path.

wfpoint_id.description: Stable identifier of the normal-flow point. Use existing ids from the input whenever the node still represents the same concept.

node_type.description: Type of this topology node. At this stage, normal topology nodes are MAIN_FLOW_POINT nodes.

name.description: Short human-readable name of the normal-flow point.

description.description: Explanation of what this normal-flow point represents in the workflow topology.

previous_node_ids.description: References that can lead into this node. Values may reference wfpoint_id, decision_gate_id, or outcome_id. When a node follows a decision gate, this field should usually reference the relevant outcome_id.

next_node_ids.description: References that may follow from this node. Values may reference wfpoint_id, decision_gate_id, or outcome_id. When a decision gate is inserted after this node, this field should reference the decision_gate_id.

confidence.description: Confidence that this node correctly represents part of the normal-flow topology.

decision_gate_node.description: A high-level decision gate inserted into the normal-flow topology. It represents a control point where the workflow selects, blocks, redirects, delays, confirms, or finalizes a path.

decision_gate_id.description: Stable identifier of the decision gate. Use sequential ids such as dg_001, dg_002, dg_003.

node_type.description: Type of this inserted topology node.

name.description: Short human-readable name of the decision gate, suitable for graph visualization.

decision_question.description: Concrete question answered by this decision gate. This is the central meaning of the gate.

decision_responsibility.description: Explanation of what this gate is responsible for deciding in the workflow.

anchored_to_node_ids.description: MAIN_FLOW_POINT ids that flow directly into this decision gate and to which the gate is semantically attached. These values map to canonical previousNodeIds.

decision_basis.description: Free human-readable list of concrete factors, conditions, inputs, confirmations, checks, or criteria used to answer the decision_question.

decision_nature_tags.description: Controlled semantic tags describing the nature of the decision. Tags are not strict gate types. Use one or more predefined values only.

outcomes.description: Logical possible results of this decision gate. Each outcome acts as an output port of the gate and may connect to existing nodes, require a new branch, remain unresolved, or leave the current workflow scope.

confidence.description: Confidence that this decision gate correctly represents a meaningful control point in the workflow topology.

decision_gate_outcome.description: A logical possible result of a DECISION_GATE. The outcome may already be attached to existing topology nodes or may describe a missing branch that should be created later.

outcome_id.description: Stable identifier of this outcome. Use the parent decision gate id plus a sequential suffix, such as dg_001_out_001.

outcome_label.description: Short machine-readable label for this outcome. Use snake_case.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this outcome means in the workflow.

connection_status.description: State of the connection between this outcome and the rest of the topology.

branch_creation_request.description: Instructions for another topology revision agent about what branch should be created for this outcome. Must be null unless connection_status is branch_candidate_needed.

next_node_ids.description: References that this outcome leads to. If connection_status is attached, this should contain at least one existing node id. If branch_candidate_needed, unresolved, or terminal_or_out_of_scope, it may be empty.

branch_creation_request.description: Request for another topology agent to create a missing branch corresponding to a decision gate outcome.

requested_branch_purpose.description: What the missing branch should represent and why it is needed.

expected_start_context.description: Where or under what condition the requested branch should start.

expected_end_or_merge_behavior.description: How the branch may end, merge back, wait, redirect, or remain uncertain.

clarification_question.description: A specific question for the user that would help resolve ambiguity in the decision gate topology.

question_id.description: Stable identifier for the clarification question. Use sequential ids such as dgq_001, dgq_002, dgq_003.

question.description: Concrete question to ask the user.

why_needed.description: Brief explanation of why this answer matters for the decision gate topology.

related_node_ids.description: Ids related to this clarification question. Values may reference wfpoint_id, decision_gate_id, or outcome_id.

blocks_next_pass.description: Whether this question blocks moving to the next agent or pass.
